name: Rampage

description.content: Whenever you basic-break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, you ear [1] Token, up to [13].
Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, for the next [13s] you gain [1%] [Haste] for each Token.

quote: "Signs of a pursuit led deep into the woods where the victim's body was found." -Port Henly Herald
